facts.fact: ECOWAS says Benin was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system for its customs administration in July 2024.
ECOWAS says Burkina Faso was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system for its customs administration in July 2024.
ECOWAS says Cote d'Ivoire was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system for its customs administration in July 2024.

CPV.note: Cabo Verde is only to adopt SIGMAT Mobile soon; not yet connected.

facts.fact: ECOWAS says Ghana was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system for its customs administration in July 2024.
ECOWAS says SIGMAT, its regional goods-in-transit data exchange system, was deployed to the Gambia's customs system in October 2024.
ECOWAS says Mali was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system in July 2024, though it also lists Mali among states preparing to put it into operation.
ECOWAS says Niger was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system for its customs administration in July 2024.

SEN.note: Senegal has finished tests and is only preparing to put SIGMAT into operation.

facts.fact: ECOWAS says Togo was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system for its customs administration in July 2024.
